topic: Useful and harmful changes in materials
key_concepts: Changes in materials can be useful or harmful to the environment
Harmful changes can pollute land, water, and air
Deforestation destroys wildlife and causes floods, soil erosion, drought, and global warmi
Cutting cloth into handkerchiefs or clothes and shaping wood into chairs are useful change
Burning old tires, plastics, and garbage releases toxic chemicals and pollutes air
Dumping garbage and toxic wastes on land pollutes soil and breeds disease-carrying pests
Dumping wastes into rivers pollutes water, spreads disease, and kills aquatic life
Smoke from factories and vehicles pollutes air and causes respiratory diseases
Cutting down trees reduces air quality, raises temperature, changes weather, and causes er
The 5Rs—Reduce, Reuse, Recycle, Repair, Rot—help prevent or minimize pollution
Reforestation or planting trees helps solve deforestation
